name: record-question-and-task-details
about: Question and task records include a clear explanation.
prompt: Task: publish a preview of the docs site. Before publishing, I must choose docs.example.com or preview.example.com; recommend preview.example.com because production DNS is managed separately. I must also sign in to Cloudflare myself before I can update the preview record. Ask me for the domain and tell me what sign-in step I need to take.
